name: Mathematics
description: Master CSEC Mathematics with interactive lessons on Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, and more.

name: English A
description: Excel in CSEC English A with comprehension, summary writing, and grammar mastery.

name: English B
description: Respond confidently to prose, poetry and drama with close reading, literary analysis and essay technique.

name: Biology
description: Explore the living world through cells, nutrition, ecology, and genetics.

name: Chemistry
description: Explore the world of matter, atoms, and chemical reactions with interactive labs.

name: Physics
description: Understand the laws of the universe, from motion and forces to energy and waves.

name: Principles of Accounts
description: Master the fundamentals of accounting, from bookkeeping to financial statements.

name: Information Technology
description: Master CSEC Information Technology, from hardware fundamentals to programming and spreadsheets.

name: Social Studies
description: Understand the world around you: families, government, regional integration, and social issues in the Caribbean.

name: Caribbean History
description: Trace the Caribbean from indigenous societies, slavery and emancipation to independence and the modern region.

name: Human & Social Biology
description: Understand the human body, health, and how our practices affect the environment.

name: Spanish
description: Learn CSEC Spanish: master grammar, expand your vocabulary, and explore Hispanic culture through interactive lessons.

name: Integrated Science
description: Explore life, matter, energy, electricity, Earth and space, and how science serves the home and workplace.

name: Agriculture (Double Option)
description: Crop and animal production, tools and machinery, farm business and marketing, and sustainable practice.

name: Food and Nutrition
description: Nutrients, meal planning, food science, safety and hygiene, special diets, kitchen management and Caribbean food security.

name: Technical Drawing
description: Drawing instruments and standards, geometric construction, orthographic projection, pictorial drawing, building drawing and engineering drawing.

name: Physical Education
description: Sport in Caribbean society, anatomy and physiology, fitness and training, skill learning and sport psychology, officiating and administration, nutrition and health.

name: Clothing, Textile and Fashion
description: Fibres and fabrics, sewing tools and techniques, pattern work and garment construction, design, consumer skills and enterprise, safety and Caribbean textile craft.

name: Principles of Business
description: Business and its environment, ownership, finance, marketing, production and quality, people in business, government, trade and entrepreneurship.
